node: AI-server passive components and board-level power delivery, including high-end MLCCs
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed universe for AI-server passives and board-level power delivery into two lanes. Reference lane includes Murata as the most direct high-end MLCC context anchor and Vicor as a direct AI-processor power-delivery specialist. Underfollowed lane includes Vishay as a US-listed passive-components/MLCC candidate requiring AI-server qualification proof, and Bel Fuse as a smaller data-center power, magnetics, connectivity, and power-shelf supplier with plausible second-order exposure to AI rack power intensity. The core chokepoint remains a hypothesis: the bottleneck is not generic capacitors, but a narrow high-capacitance, low-ESR/low-ESL, high-reliability band plus nearby high-current power-delivery architectures. Layer 1B expansion finds one direct MLCC/passives reference name and three US-listed underfollowed or lower-attention candidates tied to board-level power delivery, front-end/datacenter power, magnetics, capacitors, inductors, and power semiconductors. The strongest direct node fit is Murata via AI-server MLCC intensity, but it is an OTC ADR reference leader rather than a small/mid-cap alpha candidate. The underfollowed lane is more speculative: Vishay has broad passive-component and power-discrete exposure with explicit AI/electrification capacity investment but needs proof of high-end AI-server MLCC qualification; Vicor has explicit AI accelerator and hyperscaler power-delivery exposure; Bel Fuse has datacenter front-end power, DC-DC converters, racks/shelves, magnetics, and networking demand evidence but needs clearer AI-server customer mix.
